supersedes: approved-sources-v1 (kept unchanged for reproducibility of reports/doc_type/experiments_v3 baseline)
rule: Approved only when a PRIMARY source states terms that cover the intended use (internal, non-commercial ML research: training, evaluation, benchmarking) or the project owner holds the rights. Sources whose title/chain of rights, provenance or terms cannot be verified stay excluded until the exact permission listed under excluded_until_cleared is obtained. 'Academic use' is never read as commercial permission. No tier permits redistribution of the raw data or of derived datasets.

tier2_restricted_known_terms.rvl_cdip: research use only (IIT-CDIP derivative); no commercial use, no redistribution
tier2_restricted_known_terms.manual_in: project-owner collected; owner must attest rights and that no third-party personal data is retained - internal development only
tier2_restricted_known_terms.funsd: primary terms (EPFL-LTS5 licence page): 'solely for non-commercial, research and educational purposes'; images originate from RVL-CDIP; no redistribution; 199 forms with no document-type labels (class 'other' only)

excluded_until_cleared.in_financial: NOT APPROVED. Kaggle mehaksingal/personal-financial-dataset-for-india: images scraped from Google Images; DbCL 1.0 disclaims title (s.3.1), uploader does not claim ownership. Needed: written statement of rights from the uploader or per-image licences (or restrict to verified specimen/template images), plus confirmation that no personal data is present.
excluded_until_cleared.sroie: REQUIRES CLARIFICATION. HF mirror card says CC-BY-4.0 but the ICDAR RRC portal (data owner) shows no terms on the challenge pages and requires registration; the CC-BY marking matches the arXiv paper licence, not the data. Needed: RRC terms of use accepted at registration, or written confirmation from the organisers.
excluded_until_cleared.hf_medical: BLOCKED. No licence, no dataset card, no provenance on destryet/medical_bills (15 PDFs) or sansverse/medical-bill-samples (17 PDFs); redaction claim unverified. Needed: written permission from the uploader or the bills' issuer.
excluded_until_cleared.user_real: REQUIRES CLARIFICATION. 198 US restaurant receipts with unverified origin; owner must attest they collected them and that they hold the right to use them.
excluded_until_cleared.receiptbench: REQUIRES CLARIFICATION (tightened from approved-sources-v1 on new evidence). HF repo licence 'mit' but the README is empty: no provenance, consent or personal-data statement for real personal receipts. Needed: uploader statement on image provenance and consent, or per-image licences.
